gaps.sentence: I'll call you as soon ___ I land.

gaps.explanation: 'Neither of + plural noun + singular verb' (formal English).

gaps.sentence: We'll start the meeting ___ everyone arrives.
gaps.explanation: 'when/once/until' — here 'when everyone arrives' starts the event.

gaps.sentence: The meeting was put ___ until Thursday.
By this time next year, she ___ finished her degree.
gaps.explanation: Future perfect: will have + participle by a future point.

gaps.sentence: The concert tickets sold ___ in an hour.
The thief is believed ___ entered through the roof.
gaps.explanation: 'is believed to have + participle' for a past event.
